verdict.rationale: vLLM is fundamentally a CLI/server tool: it installs via pip/uv, offers an OpenAI-compatible API server (vllm-docs-9, vllm-docs-27), and ships an official Docker image for headless deployment (vllm-docs-26), all clearly usable without any GUI in server/CI contexts. Community evidence corroborates real-world server usage (vllm-comm-3, vllm-comm-4). missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples/config, independent hands-on report confirming headless CI usage specifically.
